caption:
UWS Briefly · Aug 27 – Sep 2

• Bobby Santangelo, a fishmonger at Broadway Farms and other UWS grocers for decades, died in August.
• B and C riders lost their Monday to track repairs at 81st Street. It took nearly 100 workers to fix.
• Velvet Cowboy opens Sept. 29 at 509 Amsterdam, where Jacob's Pickles used to be.
• The city is spraying pesticide from trucks across most of the UWS on Wednesday, for West Nile. Lovely.
• West Side Montessori bought its space at the base of the Dahlia on W. 95th for $11.4 million.
• Wu's Dynasty has its soft opening Sept. 3 at 208 W. 70th.
• Police want two people who snatched a necklace off a 75-year-old woman's neck on Aug. 2.
• The city broke ground on a 116th Street redesign with 2.5 miles of bus lanes. UWS bus routes will feel it.

Links to every story are in our bio.
Reporting by West Side Rag, I Love the Upper West Side.
